title: Etaleness at a prime descends for a faithfully flat field base change
statement: Let k be a field [def-pc-field-extension], K/k a field extension, A a commutative k-algebra, and B a finitely presented A-algebra [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Let q be a prime of B, put p=q\cap A, let B_K=B\otimes_k K and A_K=A\otimes_k K [lem-weil-pbc-algebra-tensor-base-change-universal-property], and let q_K be a prime of B_K whose contraction to B is q. Put p_K=q_K\cap A_K. If B_K is etale over A_K at q_K in the standard pointwise sense (that is, Algebra.IsEtaleAt A_K q_K; equivalently, since B_K is finitely presented over A_K, (B_K)_{q_K} is flat over (A_K)_{p_K} and (\Omega_{B_K/A_K})_{q_K}=0), then B is etale over A at q in the same standard sense (Algebra.IsEtaleAt A q).

proof.text: The base-change local map B_q \to (B_K)_{q_K} is faithfully flat by the localized field-extension statement [lem-sc-etale-local-ring-stalk-faithfully-flat].

source.place: Lemma 33.9 (Tag 0C4Y), local faithful flatness of stalks

proof.text: Since q_K\cap A=(q_K\cap B)\cap A=q\cap A=p, the prime p_K of A_K contracts to p. Applying [lem-sc-etale-local-ring-stalk-faithfully-flat] to A as a (finitely presented) A-algebra, with the primes p and p_K, shows that the local map A_p\to(A_K)_{p_K} is faithfully flat, in particular flat. B_K=A_K\otimes_A B is finitely presented over A_K (base change of finite presentation, Algebra Tag 00F4), so the etale hypothesis at q_K gives, by [lem-sc-etale-at-prime-flat-unramified-criterion] (1)=>(3), that (B_K)_{q_K} is flat over (A_K)_{p_K}. Composing flat ring maps (Algebra Tag 00HC), (B_K)_{q_K} is flat over A_p, through A_p\to B_q\to(B_K)_{q_K} as well (the square of local maps commutes). By Step 1 it is a faithfully flat B_q-module, so [lem-weil-pbc-flat-permanence] (Tag 039V) with R=A_p, S=B_q, M=(B_K)_{q_K} gives that A_p\to B_q is flat.

source.place: Lemma Tag 039V (lemma-flat-permanence) with Tags 00HC and 00F4; Varieties Tag 0C4Y(1) for A_p -> (A_K)_{p_K}

proof.text: Kahler differentials commute with the field base change: Omega_{B_K/A_K} is identified with (B_K) tensor_B Omega_{B/A} by [lem-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials-base-change]. Localizing at q_K identifies this with (B_K)_{q_K} tensor_{B_q} (Omega_{B/A})_q. The first module is zero by the etale hypothesis at q_K and [lem-sc-etale-at-prime-flat-unramified-criterion] (1)=>(3) (B_K is finitely presented over A_K, Step 2), and (B_K)_{q_K} is a faithfully flat B_q-module by Step 1, so faithful-flat tensor reflection [lem-sc-faithfully-flat-tensor-zero] gives (Omega_{B/A})_q=0.

source.place: Lemma 00RV (base change of differentials), combined with Tag 00HP

proof.text: B is finitely presented over A, B_q is flat over A_p by Step 2 and (\Omega_{B/A})_q=0 by Step 3, so [lem-sc-etale-at-prime-flat-unramified-criterion] (3)=>(1) gives Algebra.IsEtaleAt A q.
